paper_title: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants using molecular spectroscopy
suggested_experiment_name: I2 molecular spectroscopy (Expt A & B), QCD sector
notes: Paper constrains oscillating UDM coupling to quarks and gluons (QCD sector) via molecular iodine spectroscopy, frequencies 10 Hz-100 MHz (m_phi ~1e-13 to 1e-6 eV). Main exclusion (Fig 3) is on the combination QN·d = 0.999 dgs + 0.092 d_mhat + ... (gluon/quark/nucleon-mass sector), best matched to ScalarNucleon among the enum, though it also reports bounds on d_alpha (ScalarPhoton) and d_me (ScalarElectron). Numerical data is only available in plots (Figs 3-5); no tables of (mass, coupling) pairs are provided in the text, so data_points left empty. DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 for galactic halo scenario.
